items.raw_excerpt: For years, the 'Little Blue Boat' had a special place in the hearts of many in Hobart, until a storm nearly sank it for good. Now, after much hard work, this icon of southern Tasmania is ready for the water again.

items.raw_excerpt: The single census question that inflates home ownership by more than a quarter.
items.summary_en: One question in Australia's census inflates the home ownership rate by more than a quarter. People who live with their parents can count themselves as home owners. So the real ownership rate is lower than the official number.
